mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER (member_no, id, password, name, birth, rank, team_id) VALUES (NEXT VALUE FOR member_table_sequence, #{id}, #{password}, #{name}, #{birth}, #{rank}, #{teamId})
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_no , m.id , m.name , m.birth , m.rank , m.team_id , t.name AS teamName FROM MEMBER m LEFT JOIN TEAM t ON m.team_id = t.id WHERE m.member_no = #{memberNo}
